name: Saudi Advanced Industries Company
summary: Saudi Advanced Industries Company, through its subsidiary, operates in the investment and financing sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers the glass industries sector, which includes the manufacture and production of all types of glass; wholesale and retail trade of all types of glass and raw materials for the manufacture of glass and accessories; manufactures, cuts, colors and installs glass, and establishes and manages mining quarries; and this sector includes the production of different forms and types of glass, such as flat glass (used in windows, doors, and buildings), luxury glass (used in furniture and decoration), laminated glass (used in cars), heat-resistant glas…
